instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI using a max-width container (max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh]) to simulate a mobile app on desktop.
Use 'Manrope' for headings and 'Work Sans' for body text. Do not use Inter for headings.
Implement the Chat Interface using dynamic blocks rather than just text bubbles. The tools (Draft Reply, Break It Down) should be horizontal scrollable pills or a bento grid above the keyboard area.
For the Vibe Selector, create a tactile dial or a sleek segmented control at the top of the chat.
Mode Toggle (CommonGround / DeeplyUs): Use a smooth animated toggle that shifts the color palette slightly (e.g., from Sage to Terracotta accents).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-submit-button').
Use the provided image URLs for the auth background and pairing screen.
Avoid standard Shadcn cards for everything; use flat, rectangular, or heavily rounded (rounded-[2rem]) organic shapes with generous padding (p-6 or p-8).
Do NOT use teal or purple for CTAs. Stick to the Primary #9A3B26 (Terracotta) for primary actions.
